Traditional voice AI turns speech into text, generates a response, then reads it aloud. That can slow things down and miss important clues like frustration or hesitation. Rime just launched Prism, a new AI model built to make phone conversations smarter and more natural. Here's what makes it interesting: → Understands how callers sound, not just the words they use. → Lets businesses check responses before they're spoken. → Can be trained on a company's real customer calls. Rime reports Prism got customer approval before placing 94% of orders, compared to 57% with an OpenAI model. The next generation of voice AI won't just sound more human. It'll understand humans better. Check out Prism and try it for free.
